## 0. Setup

### Load packages

```{r}
library(rstan)
library(ctsem)
library(tidybayes)
library(furrr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
```

### Set up functions

```{r}
#function for running univariate models----------------------------------------
model_fun <- function(sid, sample, domain){
  
  filestr <- paste0(c(sample, sid, domain), collapse = "-")
  load(
    file = paste0(
      "../02-data/02-clean-data/univ-facets/rdata/",filestr, ".RData"
    )
  )
  print(filestr)
  # initial mean 
  m_pers <- x %>% pull(score) %>% mean(., na.rm = T)
  #cint_ind <- paste0("mu_x | 2.5*param+", m_pers) # NEW
  model_1 <- ctModel(
    type = "stanct"
    , manifestNames = c("score")
    , latentNames   = c("X")
    , LAMBDA        = matrix(c(1), nrow = 1, byrow = T)
    , DRIFT         = matrix(c("beta_x"), nrow = 1, byrow = T)
    #set cts intercept
    , CINT          = matrix(c("mu_x"), nrow = 1, byrow = T)
    , T0MEANS       = matrix(c(mean(m_pers, na.rm = T)))
    #basically, keep error term w/in a certain range
    , DIFFUSION     = matrix(c("sigma_x | 2.5*param + 1.5"), nrow = 1, byrow = T) 
    , id            = "SID"
    , time          = "time"
  )
  
  # ctModelLatex(m)
  
  # run the model
  
  model_1$pars$indvarying <- FALSE
  fit <- ctStanFit(data = x, model_1,priors=T,optimize=F)
  
  save(fit, file = sprintf("../04-results/univ-facets/models/%s.RData", filestr))
  
  # estimate attractor locations from posterior
  sum_fun <- function(x){
    inter <- quantile(x, probs = c(.025, .5, .975))
    tibble(
      parameter = "location"
      , mean = mean(x)
      , sd = sd(x)
      , lower = inter[1]
      , mid = inter[2]
      , upper = inter[3]
    )
  }
  
  samples <- ctExtract(fit)$popmeans
  colnames(samples) <- rownames(summary(fit)$popmeans)
  loc <- sum_fun(-1*samples[,"mu_x"]/samples[,"beta_x"])
  
  # save key params
  fx <- summary(fit)$popmeans %>%
    data.frame() %>%
    setNames(c("mean", "sd", "lower", "mid", "upper","n_eff","rhat")) %>%
    rownames_to_column("parameter") %>%
    full_join(loc)
  # save(fx, file = sprintf("../04-results/univ/fx/%s.RData",filestr))  
  save(fx, file = sprintf("../04-results/univ-facets/fx/%s.RData",filestr))
}
```

## 02. Process model results

### Import the model results + central traits

#### Helper function for importing model results

```{r}
#function for importing univ models
import_fx = function(sample,sid,domain){
  filestr <- paste0(c(sample, sid, domain), collapse = "-")

  load(
    file = paste0(
      "../04-results/univ/fx/"
      , filestr
      , ".RData"
    ))
  print(filestr)
  return(fx)
}
```

#### Import the data

```{r}
traits = read_csv("../02-data/02-clean-data/traits/central-traits-scored-poles.csv") %>%
  unique()

#import central traits data + n observations per person
auxdat0 = read_csv('../02-data/02-clean-data/subj-lvl-data.csv') %>%
  unique() %>%
  select(-is_central)

auxdat = auxdat0 %>%
  merge(traits,by=c('sample','SID','domain'))
```

```{r include=FALSE}
all_univ.names = tibble(file = list.files("../04-results/univ/fx/")) %>%
  separate(file, c("sample", "SID", "domain"), sep = "-") %>%
  mutate(
    domain= str_remove_all(domain, ".RData")
    , model = "RQ1")

all_univ.imp = all_univ.names %>%
  mutate(fx = pmap(list(sample,SID,domain),possibly(import_fx,NA_real_)))

all_univ = all_univ.imp %>%
  unnest(cols = c(fx)) %>%
  mutate(sample = tolower(sample)) %>%
  mutate(domain = plyr::mapvalues(domain,c('E','A','C','N','O'), c('EXT','AGR','CON','NEU','OPE'))) %>%
  #we lost one person from SC in this step who didn't have CTs
  merge(auxdat,by=c('sample','SID','domain')) %>%
  mutate(domain = factor(domain,c("EXT",'AGR',"CON","NEU","OPE"))) %>%
  filter(!(SID %in% c('628','1256_B','18975')))

#save out the data w/o initial exclusions applied
write_csv(all_univ, "../02-data/02-clean-data/all-univ-and-traits-merged.csv")
```

### Apply exclusions based on attractor model results

```{r}
all.univ00 = read_csv("../02-data/02-clean-data/all-univ-and-traits-merged.csv")

```

```{r}
all.univ0 = all.univ00 %>%
  #identify models w/ parameters that fail our exclusions
  mutate(drop_param = case_when(
    parameter == 'location' & mean < 0 ~ 1,
    parameter == 'location' & mean > 10 ~ 1,
    parameter == 'beta_x' & mean > 0 ~ 1,
    parameter == 'mu_x' & sd > 10 ~ 1,
    parameter == 'beta_x' & sd > 10 ~ 1,
    .default = 0
  )) %>%
  #identify models where any parameter fails our exclusions
  group_by(sample,SID,domain) %>%
  mutate(drop_strict = as.numeric(any(drop_param == 1))) %>%
  ungroup() 
```

### Set up "strict" + "chill" versions of the data, then export

Strict = exclude models where ANY of our exclusions apply; Chill = exclude just the parameters for which exclusions apply

```{r}
all.univ.strict = all.univ0 %>%
  filter(drop_strict == 0) %>%
  mutate(version = 'strict') %>%
  group_by(version) %>%
  nest()

all.univ.chill = all.univ0 %>%
  filter(drop_param == 0) %>%
  mutate(version = 'chill') %>%
  group_by(version) %>%
  nest() 

#combine together and apply final wrangling
all.univ = rbind(all.univ.strict,all.univ.chill) %>%
  mutate(data = map(data, ~.x %>%
                      filter(parameter %in% c('beta_x','location')) %>%
                      mutate(parameter = str_replace(parameter,'beta_x','strength')) %>%
                      select(sample,SID,domain,parameter,mean,sd,is_central,ct_high,ct_low,n_obs) %>%
                      pivot_wider(names_from=parameter,values_from=c(mean,sd)) %>%
                      mutate(se_strength = sd_strength/sqrt(n_obs),
                             se_location = sd_location/sqrt(n_obs)) %>%
                      pivot_longer(-c(sample,SID,domain,is_central,ct_high,ct_low,n_obs),
                                   names_to=c('stat','parameter'),
                                   values_to='value',names_sep='_') %>%
                      pivot_wider(names_from=stat,values_from=value) %>%
                      mutate(domain = as.character(domain)) )) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(data)) %>%
  mutate(vi = sd^2)

#export fully pre-processed version of the data
write_csv(all.univ,"../02-data/02-clean-data/all-univ-and-traits-merged-CLEAN.csv")
```
